repair.content: Replace the auxiliary domain by \(\overline{\operatorname{conv}}(\mathcal Z)\) and require the fairness function to be convex and Lipschitz there. Constant average vectors become feasible, and Jensen proves equivalence. The supplied correction proves the Euclidean zero-switching performance case; it does not establish the full general-reference, positive-switching theorem.
